title: SkillSentry: Adaptive Honey Worlds for Dynamic Safety Testing of Agent Skills
title_zh: SkillSentry：用于 Agent Skill 动态安全测试的自适应蜜罐世界
abstract_en: External skills extend the capabilities of large language model agents, but also introduce an execution-time attack surface: a skill that appears benign under inspection may reveal harmful behavior only after particular environmental states, resources, or interaction histories are encountered. Existing scanners primarily rely on static analysis, predefined rules, or one-shot semantic judgments, making such conditional behavior difficult to elicit and attribute. We present SkillSentry, a dynamic safety-testing framework based on adaptive honey worlds. SkillSentry infers the intended capability boundary of a skill, constructs an LLM-simulated environment with controlled decoy resources, and adaptively generates tasks to explore its behavioral states. It then compares skill-enabled trajectories with matched no-skill executions, grounding suspicious behaviors in source code and verified execution traces before making a final decision. We evaluate SkillSentry against seven scanner configurations. SkillSentry achieves 99.50% Recall and 96.26% average F1 on standard benchmarks. Under semantics-preserving evasion, it reaches 92.95% average F1, compared with 80.07% for the strongest baselines. Our code is available at https://github.com/nizhangli062-jpg/SkillSentry-Adaptive-Honey-Worlds-for-Dynamic-Safety-Testing-of-Agent-Skills.
abstract_zh: 外部 Skill 扩展了大语言模型 Agent 的能力，但也引入了运行时攻击面：某个 Skill 在静态检查时看似无害，却可能在特定环境状态、资源或交互历史下暴露有害行为。现有扫描器主要依赖静态分析、预定义规则或一次性语义判断，难以触发并归因这类条件性恶意行为。本文提出 SkillSentry，一个基于自适应蜜罐世界（adaptive honey worlds）的动态安全测试框架。SkillSentry 会推断 Skill 的预期能力边界，构建带有受控诱饵资源的 LLM 模拟环境，并自适应生成任务以探索其行为状态。随后，它将启用 Skill 的执行轨迹与匹配的无 Skill 执行进行对比，并在最终判定前，将可疑行为关联到源代码和可验证执行轨迹。实验中，SkillSentry 相比七种扫描器配置，在标准基准上达到 99.50% Recall 和 96.26% 平均 F1；在语义保持规避攻击下达到 92.95% 平均 F1，显著优于最强基线的 80.07%。
key_points_zh: 提出 SkillSentry，通过自适应 honey worlds 对 Agent 外部 Skill 进行动态安全测试，而非仅依赖静态扫描或一次性语义判断。
框架会推断 Skill 的正常能力边界，并构造含受控 decoy resources 的 LLM-simulated environment，以诱发隐藏的条件性恶意行为。
采用 skill-enabled trajectories 与 matched no-skill executions 对比，减少误报，并将可疑行为 grounding 到源代码和可验证执行轨迹。
在标准基准上取得 99.50% Recall 和 96.26% 平均 F1，显示出较强的恶意 Skill 检出能力。
在 semantics-preserving evasion 场景下仍达到 92.95% 平均 F1，优于最强基线的 80.07%，表明其对规避变体更鲁棒。

llm_assessment.comment: Strong agent-security infrastructure paper that uses adaptive environments and execution traces to test unsafe external skills.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 这是一篇很强的智能体安全基础设施论文，利用自适应环境和执行轨迹测试外部技能风险。
